reason: Every commercial green chutney I have tried tastes sour, chemical, and heavily preserved with vinegar; nothing beats fresh dhaniya-pudina ground at home.
objection: Packaged green chutney always tastes like chemicals and vinegar, never like fresh homemade dhaniya-pudina
would_change_my_mind: Clear proof that it is preservative-free without synthetic vinegar taste, or a free trial sample.
